about: Sample data for states and screens that the reference Outing does not hold. Nothing here is measured, and no screen shows it as if it were: each screen that uses it says so in its note. Names of Places, times and distances of the reference Outing are never taken from this file.

options.about: The first two Routes offered are real: the reference Outing, and the same Route without the Place named in outing.json → study.skip_order, whose way round was found on the pedestrian graph. The third is a sample: a subset of the same Places with times that were not measured.

nothing_fits.about: A request that cannot be met: half an hour from the same start. The nearest Place is the first of the reference Outing; the walk to it is measured, the walk back is taken as the same leg.

custom_place.about: A Custom Place added while editing, to show a broken constraint: its visit makes the Route longer than the budget.

battery.about: A sample of the state in which the charge will not last the Outing.

shorten.about: The request of SC-1: forty minutes left. What the planner would keep is not computed here.

pack.about: A sample of a download under way.

account.about: A sample person on a reserved example domain.

corrections.about: Samples of the three outcomes of a Correction. The sentence each is attached to is a sentence of the cited passage in story.json, by its index.

code.about: Digits typed into a one-time code: some so far, and six that do not match.

party.about: The Party of scenario SC-2: five people on a Saturday at 14:00 for about three hours. The first names are those of the specification's scenarios; who has answered, what each likes and rules out, the votes and the messages are samples. The Places, times and distances shown with this Party are those of the reference Outing.

options.about: What each Route offered to the Party gives to whom (PTY-8). The Routes are the three of `options`; the lines are samples written from what those Routes really hold: early twentieth-century buildings, seen from outside, and a Break. None of them has a park, and the line says so: it never promises that a Route suits everyone.

lines.ru: Вся архитектура для Ани, кофе в середине для Димы; парка нет — Оле меньше всех
lines.en: All the architecture for Anya, coffee halfway for Dima; no park — least for Olya

lines.ru: То же без одного места: спокойнее для всех, Ане чуть меньше
lines.en: The same without one place: calmer for everyone, a little less for Anya

lines.ru: На час короче: кофе для Димы, половина архитектуры для Ани
lines.en: An hour shorter: coffee for Dima, half of the architecture for Anya

chat.about: Sample messages of the Chat of the Party. The system events are those the specification names.

text.en: I am for the first option
The second for me — it is calmer

text.ru: Встречаемся у вокзала за десять минут до начала
text.en: We meet at the station ten minutes before the start

catalog.about: Samples for the Catalog of stage S3. The Routes are the three of `options`: two measured and one sample; their titles, Authors, ratings, numbers of Outings and Reviews are samples. A Review says nothing about history.

title.ru: Без спешки: архитектура начала XX века

text.ru: Прошли за три часа, как и обещано. Рассказы короткие и по делу.
text.en: It took three hours, as promised. The stories are short and to the point.

text.ru: Слушала на английском, пока Павел слушал на русском. Удобно.
text.en: I listened in English while Pavel listened in Russian. It just worked.
